iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ICAP_RESPONSE
       ICAP response processed.

DESCRIPTION
       ICAP response headers have been received but the result has not yet been communicated back to the HTTP adaptation virtual
       server.	The ICAP::status command may be used to obtain the status code.  The encapsulated HTTP request or response has not
       yet been received.

Examples
	when ICAP_RESPONSE {
	    ICAP::header remove X-ICAP-my-custom-header
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.3.0 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
